about: The written WIP decisions (W6.39, W10.G6), one per wave pair over its limit while the next wave has started. Moved here from plan.json's schedule (review 12, M3) so CODEOWNERS can own them. Each freezes its counts and its ids (openIds: the wave's ⏳ tasks below browser; startedIds: the next wave's started tasks); plan:check fails on any other id, and the ledger ratchet (scripts/plan/ledgerRatchet.mjs) only lets the numbers go down, except for work newly recorded in plan/merged-while-frozen.json.

decisions.decision: Decided by Claude (lane D1) under the owner's delegation of 16.11.2026 21:53 ("decide alone, without stopping"); record: plan/decisions-2026-11-16-d1.md §1. Wave 1's 23 open tasks are built and tested in Node; lifting them to browser or real needs the Mac run, which the owner set after every cloud task. So wave 2's 25 started tasks keep going, but nothing grows: no new start in wave 2 (the frozen-wave gate, plan/wip-frozen.json, blocks it too), and every task verified lowers these numbers. Remove this once wave 1 is verified.
